pages.text: The **Hydraulic Excavator** works a square patch layer by layer, starting at its face. Mount it on the **bottom** face to dig down, or on a side to tunnel. Set the size with **radius** (0 = one block wide, 4 = nine) and **depth** (up to 32 layers).

rows: Working fluid (water) in its fluid binding
A tool in its tool lane

pages.text: With **preview** on, green sparks mark the corners of the first and last layer. The work position is saved with the world, so a reload never digs a block twice or loses its drops. Air, fluids and block entities are skipped. At a protected or unbreakable block the excavator **stops** with a fault on its **fault** channel (ch 8) and waits for you. When the area is finished it drives **done** (ch 7). Change the **job** number to start the same area again.
